InstallPage.title: Install Buttler
InstallPage.description: Set up your GitHub App in one click, or enter your credentials manually below.

manifest.organizationHelp: Leave blank to create the app under your personal account.
manifest.publicHelp: Public apps can be installed on any GitHub account or organization. Private apps can only be installed on the account that owns them.

manual.setupUrlHint: In your GitHub App settings (General → Post installation), set Setup URL to the address below and enable Redirect on update. Otherwise GitHub won't send you back to Buttler after installation.
manual.privateKeyHelp: Paste the PEM contents or upload the .pem file generated in your GitHub App settings.
manual.webhookSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank if webhooks are not configured

linkRequired.title: Open the setup link
linkRequired.description: Only the person who started Buttler can set it up. Open the link that <command>buttler start</command> has printed. If you don't have it anymore, run the command again.

DashboardPage.title: Services
DashboardPage.subtitle: Manage and monitor your running services and containers in real time.

export.title: Export services
export.description: Download a file to create the same services on another Buttler. The values of secrets are left out, and so are the links to the services that aren't chosen.

import.title: Import services
import.description: Choose a file that was exported from Buttler. Nothing is created if a name, a domain or a port is already taken.
import.imported: {count, plural, one {# service was imported.} other {# services were imported.}}
import.waitingHelp: Their secrets were left out of the file. Fill them in with "Edit environment variables" on the page of each service, then start it.
